title: Factorise a non-monic quadratic with positive terms

source_reference.notes: Original Edexcel 4MA1 Higher-style item for the Year 10 quadratics MVP. Edexcel pivot metadata applied.

student_prompt: Show your working and give your answer in factorised form.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: This is not a monic quadratic. The leading coefficient 2 must appear in one of the brackets.
Your bracket check must create 7x from the two middle products.

hint_ladder.title: What changes when the leading coefficient is not 1?
hint_ladder.prompt: This quadratic needs the non-monic method rather than the simple x^2 + bx + c routine. One bracket must carry the leading coefficient.

hint_ladder.title: Pick a starting move
hint_ladder.prompt: Set up first terms in the brackets so they multiply to the leading term. Then test constant choices by checking the middle term.

hint_ladder.title: A common slip
hint_ladder.prompt: Many students ignore the leading coefficient and build two x-brackets. Check that expanding your first terms recreates the original leading term.

hint_ladder.title: The general pattern
hint_ladder.prompt: For ax^2 + bx + c with a not equal to 1, choose bracket first terms that multiply to ax^2, then choose constants so the cross-products combine to bx. Apply this pattern; do not copy an example.

common_errors: treats it like x^2 + bx + c
does not include 2x in a bracket
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: The stuck point is accounting for the leading coefficient.

expected_solution_steps.action: choose constants and check middle term
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: The stuck point is checking the middle term produced by the two brackets.

mark_scheme_notes: Award method credit for a valid non-monic bracket structure; full credit for (2x + 1)(x + 3).
examiner_report_notes: Likely errors: treating the item as monic, failing to check the middle coefficient.
metacognition_prompt: Before you start, what changes because the coefficient of x^2 is not 1?
